reason: In config/routes.rb (patch lines 438-446), the patch removes `post_number: /\d+/` from both summary routes, leaving only `{topic_id: /\d+/}`. It also moves the moderator-liked route below `t/:topic_id/wordpress`. Neither change has anything to do with the unsubscribe feature the patch adds. The routes have no :post_number segment, so the removed constraint probably did nothing anyway.
